title: Letter Sounds A–Z
description: Learn and review the most common sounds for all 26 letters through picture-based activities and a mixed Sound Detective challenge.
learningFocus: Connect each letter with its most common sound and identify pictures that begin with that sound.
adultGuidance: Say each sound clearly without adding an extra vowel, then ask your child to name each picture aloud before choosing an answer.
